source_issues.issue: Intro groups wrong-device tensors among silently bad training; the device section alternates runtime errors and silent slowness without specifying the operation. Cross-device incompatibility is not generally a silent failure.
source_issues.disposition: Source pedagogical simplification retained; translation introduces no extra guarantee.

source_issues.issue: 80% of AI bugs in levels1/2 and 60% of time in loading are presented without workload evidence; num_workers>0 is treated as the fix even though worker/process overhead and workload determine benefit.
source_issues.disposition: Numeric claims preserved; no timing benchmark of the source default or universal performance proof claimed.

source_issues.issue: debug_print assumes a nonempty tensor supporting mean/min/max/isnan; gradients may be None and integer mean is not generally valid. These API preconditions are not stated.
source_issues.disposition: Source function unchanged; Torch unavailable, so not dynamically tested.

source_issues.issue: training_step omits zero_grad and the breakpoint precedes backward, so current-step gradients are not yet available there; line-profiler snippet also leaves gradient lifecycle to external context.
source_issues.disposition: Teaching snippets are not treated as complete training programs or executed.

source_issues.issue: perf_counter around GPU work lacks synchronization; host wall time can exclude unfinished asynchronous device computation.
source_issues.disposition: Only original Timer on finite stdlib work executed; no GPU timing claim.

source_issues.issue: cProfile report aggregates statistics by function; “every function call” can be misread as a chronological per-call trace. Chinese mirrors this source wording.
source_issues.disposition: Independent cProfile sanity output demonstrates a cumulative function table, not full lesson training performance.

source_issues.issue: tracemalloc traces Python-managed allocations, not all native tensor storage; using it to imply complete CPU model/dataset memory accounting is too broad. memory_profiler/line_profiler/TensorBoard installation examples also exceed this repo AGENTS dependency allowlist.
source_issues.disposition: Actual no-torch bytearray branch run; no package installed and no claim of Torch memory coverage.

source_issues.issue: empty_cache releases unused cached allocator blocks rather than live tensors; del only removes one reference; mixed precision does not guarantee all training memory is halved.
source_issues.disposition: Source checklist and API strings unchanged, no CUDA action executed.

source_issues.issue: Forward module hooks do not capture every functional/intermediate shape; hook cleanup lacks try/finally if forward fails. no_grad does not itself switch training/eval state. Module hook assumes shape-bearing first input.
source_issues.disposition: Coverage statement retained as source limitation, not endorsed as exhaustive tracing.

source_issues.issue: NaN can arise from invalid operations without exploding magnitudes. detect_nan only checks gradients when loss is NaN and ignores standalone Inf loss/grad anomalies. Dividing a nonzero value by zero yields Inf rather than necessarily NaN.
source_issues.disposition: No artificial Torch substitute; source detector not claimed a universal NaN/Inf monitor.

source_issues.issue: 99% accuracy alone is not proof of a bug. ID intersection catches overlapping IDs but not all leakage. Sorting timestamps alone does not guarantee a leakage-free split or fit pipeline.
source_issues.disposition: Faithful translation; no source lesson or quiz repaired.

source_issues.issue: check_devices uses first parameter only; parameterless models raise StopIteration and mixed-device parameters/buffers are not fully audited.
source_issues.disposition: Retained helper preconditions; no broad device-health pass asserted.

source_issues.issue: TensorBoard snippet calls train_step(model,batch) whereas earlier train_step requires model,data,target; optimizer/num_steps/batch need external context.
source_issues.disposition: Snippet context mismatch preserved, no training/server start attempted.

source_issues.issue: The six TensorBoard observations are heuristic; weight values collapsing to zero do not prove vanishing gradients and large gradients do not uniquely require clipping. Learning-rate conclusions likewise are not exhaustive diagnoses.
source_issues.disposition: Cause phrasing follows source; risks separate from translation fidelity.

source_issues.disposition: Default main explicitly never executed; bounded stdlib subset only, zero training steps.
